map.由功率与转速换算旋转轴的输出转矩（及角速度）。: Convert speed and power into the output torque of a rotating shaft (and angular velocity).
map.P = T·ω/1000 应回等于输入功率: P = T·ω/1000 should convert back to the input power
map.亦可用 T = P/ω（P:W，ω:rad/s）: You can also use T = P/ω (P in W, ω in rad/s)
map.校验行 P=T·ω/1000 应回等于输入功率: The check row P=T·ω/1000 should convert back to the input power
map.在功率、转矩、转速三者间快速换算，用于: Convert quickly between power, torque and speed for
map.由: Derive the output torque from power
map.与转速推算输出转矩，判断是否满足负载转矩要求。: and speed, and judge whether the load torque requirement is met.
map.校核减速机输出端的转矩与功率匹配。: Check the torque and power matching at the reducer output.
map.转矩 T = 9550·P/n（N·m，P 为 kW、n 为 r/min）；: Torque T = 9550·P/n (N·m, with P in kW and n in r/min);
map.ω = 2π·n/60（rad/s）；校验功率 P = T·ω/1000（kW）: ω = 2π·n/60 (rad/s); check power P = T·ω/1000 (kW). The coefficient 9550 comes from the engineering rounding of 60×1000/(2π) ≈ 9549.3.
map.功率 P=7.5 kW、转速 n=1450 r/min：T = 9550×7.5: With power P=7.5 kW and speed n=1450 r/min: T = 9550×7.5/1450 ≈ 49.4 N·m; ω = 2π×1450/60 ≈ 151.84 rad/s; the back-calculated power = 49.4×151.84/1000 ≈ 7.5 kW, matching the input (cross-checking). This is exactly the rated operating point of a common 4-pole asynchronous motor at 50 Hz.
map.9550 这个系数怎么来的？: Where does the coefficient 9550 come from?
map.由 T(N·m) = P(W)/ω(rad/s) 且 ω = 2πn/60 推得: From T(N·m) = P(W)/ω(rad/s) together with ω = 2πn/60, giving T = 60×P(kW)×1000/(2π×n) ≈ 9549.3·P/n; engineering practice rounds this to 9550 for easier memorisation and hand calculation, and the error is negligible.
map.为什么同功率下转速越低转矩越大？: Why is torque larger at lower speed for the same power?
map.因为功率是转矩与角速度的乘积（P = T·ω），功率一定时转矩与转速成反比；所以: Because power is the product of torque and angular velocity (P = T·ω), so at fixed power torque is inversely proportional to speed. A reducer therefore amplifies torque in proportion as it lowers speed (minus efficiency losses), which is the principle behind fitting a reducer to heavy-load low-speed equipment.
